workflow_mapping.core-cam/financials: Audited / provisional financials → financial analysis → repayment assessment → resilience assessment → CAM
workflow_mapping.core-cam/credit-request: Credit request → credit assessment (facility details) → credit challenge → credit decision → CAM
workflow_mapping.core-cam/banking-debt: Banking / existing debt → repayment assessment, credit history → credit decision
workflow_mapping.core-cam/credit-history: Bureau / CRILC / rating → credit history (CAM section 5) → risk identification
workflow_mapping.core-cam/borrower-corporate: KYC / MCA / shareholding → validation document checklist → borrower profile
workflow_mapping.conditional/security: Security / valuation → security cover (repayment secondary source) → facility structure → recommendation
workflow_mapping.conditional/working-capital: Debtor / creditor ageing → risk identification → due diligence → credit challenge → repayment assessment
